newsitem.title: USA: Chirex to dissolve InNova venture.
newsitem.headline: Chirex to dissolve InNova venture.

text.p: Chirex Inc said Friday it would quicken the process to sell its acetaminophen business and had agreed to dissolve its InNova Pharmaceuticals SRL joint venture with Dabur India Ltd.
The impact of the InNova dissolution on earnings will be negligible, Chirex said. It did not provide details and company officials were not available for comment.

Chirex originally sought to utilize InNova as a secure supply source of starting material for semi-synthetic paclitaxel, it said. Recently, new suppliers of paclitaxel have emerged, mitigating InNova's competitive advantage, the company said.
Chirex said it expects to maintain commercial supply arrangements with Dabur.
The company described the acetaminophen business as "low-margin."
